title: Level 4: DOM & Events
description: Comprehensive guide to DOM manipulation, event handling, traversal, and dynamic content creation.

notes.title: DOM Tree Fundamentals
notes.content: The DOM represents HTML as a tree of objects where each element is a 'node'.
notes.deepDive: Nodes include elements (nodeType=1), text (nodeType=3), and comments. Use parentNode, childNodes, and sibling properties for traversal.

notes.title: Element Selection Methods
notes.content: Different methods to select DOM elements with varying performance characteristics.
notes.deepDive: getElementById is fastest. querySelectorAll returns static NodeList. Prefer IDs for frequent access.

notes.title: Element Creation & Insertion
notes.content: Creating new DOM elements and inserting them efficiently.
notes.deepDive: innerHTML causes re-parsing. DocumentFragment allows batch DOM operations without reflow.

notes.title: Event Bubbling vs Capturing
notes.codeSnippet:
elem.addEventListener('click', handler, true); // Capturing phase
el.addEventListener('click', handler); // Bubbling (default)
notes.deepDive: Use event.stopPropagation() to halt propagation. Bubbling enables event delegation.

notes.title: Event Delegation Pattern
notes.content: Attach events to parent elements to handle dynamic children.
notes.deepDive: Reduces memory footprint. Works for dynamically added elements. Use element.closest() for nested targets.

notes.title: Form Validation Techniques
notes.deepDive: Combine HTML5 validation (required, pattern) with JavaScript. Use Constraint Validation API.

notes.title: Dynamic Styling with JavaScript
notes.deepDive: Prefer class toggling over inline styles for maintainability. Use getComputedStyle() to read final styles.

notes.title: Data Attributes Usage
notes.content: Store custom data in HTML attributes.
notes.deepDive: dataset property converts kebab-case to camelCase. Great for component configuration.

notes.title: Keyboard Event Handling
notes.deepDive: Use key instead of keyCode for modern browsers. Consider accessibility (tabindex, focus management).

notes.title: Custom Event Creation
notes.deepDive: Enables decoupled communication between components. Use bubbles: true for propagation.

notes.title: MutationObserver API
notes.deepDive: Efficient alternative to polling. Use for tracking dynamic content changes.

notes.title: Performance Optimization
notes.deepDive: Minimize layout thrashing. Use requestAnimationFrame for visual updates. Debounce scroll/resize handlers.

mcqs.question: Which method selects the first <div> in the DOM?
mcqs.explanation: querySelector uses CSS selectors to return the first match.

mcqs.question: What does `event.preventDefault()` do?
options: Prevents default browser behavior (e.g., form submission)
mcqs.correctAnswer: Prevents default browser behavior (e.g., form submission)
mcqs.explanation: Useful for custom form handling or disabling anchor navigation.

mcqs.question: How do you add 'active' class to an element?
mcqs.explanation: classList provides methods to add/remove/toggle classes.

mcqs.question: What is event delegation?
options: Handling events at parent level for dynamic children
mcqs.correctAnswer: Handling events at parent level for dynamic children
mcqs.explanation: Leverages event bubbling to handle events from multiple elements with single listener.

mcqs.question: Which property contains event target?
mcqs.explanation: event.target is the element that triggered the event, while currentTarget is where listener is attached.

mcqs.question: How to remove all children from a DOM element?
mcqs.explanation: Most efficient method. innerHTML='' also works but may cause memory leaks with event handlers.

mcqs.question: What does insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html) do?
mcqs.explanation: Positions: 'beforebegin', 'afterbegin', 'beforeend', 'afterend'. Faster than innerHTML for appending.

mcqs.question: How to get next sibling element?
mcqs.explanation: nextSibling returns any node (including text), nextElementSibling returns only element nodes.

mcqs.question: What triggers DOMContentLoaded event?
mcqs.explanation: Fires after HTML is completely parsed, without waiting for stylesheets/images.

mcqs.question: How to detect clicks outside an element?
mcqs.explanation: Check if event target is outside element using Node.contains().

mcqs.question: What is MutationObserver used for?
mcqs.explanation: Efficiently observe additions/removals of DOM nodes or attribute changes.

mcqs.question: How to make element draggable?
mcqs.explanation: Requires HTML attribute. Implement dragstart/dragover/drop handlers for full functionality.

mcqs.question: What does event.stopImmediatePropagation() do?
options: Prevents other listeners on same element
mcqs.correctAnswer: Prevents other listeners on same element
mcqs.explanation: stopPropagation() stops bubbling. stopImmediatePropagation() also prevents other listeners on same element.

mcqs.question: How to clone a DOM element?
mcqs.explanation: Pass true to deep clone with all descendants. False clones only the element itself.

mcqs.question: What is passive event listener?
mcqs.explanation: Improves scroll performance. Declare with { passive: true } in addEventListener options.

mcqs.question: How to check if element has class?
mcqs.explanation: classList API provides contains(), add(), remove(), and toggle() methods.

mcqs.question: What triggers input event?
mcqs.explanation: Fires immediately after value change (unlike change event which fires on blur).

mcqs.question: How to get element's dimensions?
mcqs.explanation: Returns {width, height, top, left, right, bottom} relative to viewport.

mcqs.question: What is event.key for spacebar?
mcqs.explanation: event.key returns ' ' for spacebar. Use event.code for physical key ('Space').

mcqs.question: How to trigger event programmatically?
mcqs.explanation: Create event with new Event(type) and dispatch with dispatchEvent().
